summary: tmk, two load-bearing issues in the plan: an impossible documentation acceptance check and incomplete coverage of evaluation during compilation. No files changed.

findings.title: [P2] Reconcile the documentation grep with the required historical section
findings.body: Task 2 step 3 requires adding “Rejected: a managed runtime” and a link whose filename contains “managed”. Both match step 1’s case-insensitive search across doc/. Step 6 therefore cannot print nothing and exit 1 after the prescribed edits. The State table’s expected zero matches has the same contradiction.
findings.recommendation: Explicitly allow the historical section and its citation, while checking that active behavior descriptions and removed symbol references are gone. Update the expected grep result accordingly.

findings.title: [P2] Prove that the first-compile evaluation answers before compilation finishes
findings.body: The test checks :last-build-provides before opening the nREPL connection, cloning a session, selecting the build, and sending the evaluation. Compilation can finish between that check and the actual request. It also asserts only the eventual error text, so an implementation that waits for compilation before returning that error can pass. This leaves Review Focus item 1’s explicit “not a wait” contract unverified; deleting the cache only makes the race less likely.
findings.recommendation: Define deterministic coordination with the real compilation so the request and response occur while compilation remains in progress, and bound the response time. Ensure the test fails if evaluation waits for compilation to finish.
